# Reelwright parity with HyperFrames and the nine audited repos

<!-- Generated by tools/parity_compile.mjs from docs/parity/*.md. Do not hand-edit: change the rows in docs/parity/ and re-run `node tools/parity_compile.mjs`. -->

Compiled 2026-11-14 from the five per-source checklists in [docs/parity/](parity/). One row per audited feature; the status is the word at the start of the row's status cell. See [the Phase 10 plan](plans/phase-10-parity.md) for the goal and the per-source audit notes.

**Legend.** EQUAL: Reelwright does it as well. BETTER: Reelwright does it better. EQUAL/BETTER: the row says both. PARTIAL: some of it. MISSING: not there. OUT: excluded by owner decision or repo rule. N/A: the row says not applicable. OTHER: UNVERIFIED or DIFFERENT. A row marked EQUAL/BETTER whose own text also names a MISSING or PARTIAL piece is counted PARTIAL and tagged `(mixed)`.
